Enantioselective synthesis of isoxazolines bearing
allenes by palladium-catalyzed carboetherification
of β,γ-unsaturated ketoximes with propargylic
acetates†
Feifei Jin,<sup>a</sup> Cangzhu Hu,<sup>a</sup> Shuaijie Wu,<sup>a</sup> Guodong Zhang, <sup>a</sup> Ying Han,<sup>a</sup>
Chao-Guo Yan, <sup>a</sup> Wenbo Li,*<sup>b</sup> Chaoshen Zhang*<sup>c</sup> and Lei Wang *<sup>a</sup>
Received 11th December 2024,
Accepted 23rd January 2025
A highly eficient Pd-catalyzed enantioselective carboetherification reaction of β,γ-unsaturated ketoximes
with propargylic acetates is demonstrated. This method provides various chiral isoxazolines bearing multi-
substituted allene groups in good yields with excellent enantioselectivities. The sterically electron-rich
BINOL-derived phosphoramidite ligand exhibits highly eficient control over both chemoselectivity and
enantioselectivity. The salient features of this reaction include readily available starting materials, broad
functional group tolerance, an easy scale-up, versatile transformations and promising photo-physical pro-
perties. DFT calculations were carried out to disclose the detailed mechanism and origins of the
enantioselectivity.

also serve as potential precursors in the synthesis of many bio-

Consequently, the development of novel methodologies to syn-

developed a novel palladium-catalyzed asymmetric alleneami-

\beta , \gamma \cdot

Results and discussion
With the optimized conditions in hand, the scope of pro-
pargylic acetates 1 was first examined as shown in Scheme 2.
For example, a variety of propargylic acetates bearing electron-
donating or electron-withdrawing groups at the para position
of the phenyl ring were all well tolerated, and aforded the
desired products 3b–3h in moderate to excellent yields with
91–92% ees. Notably, substrates with aryl groups bearing
ortho- and meta-substituents were also applicable to give the
desired products 3i and 3j in 71–78% yields with 90–91% ees.
Moreover, 2-naphthyl propargylic acetates could be
employed to deliver the corresponding product 3k in 81%
yield with 91% ee. The absolute configuration of 3k was con-
firmed by X-ray crystallography analysis.<sup>17</sup> Heteroarene and
1-ethynylcyclohex-1-ene substituted propargylic acetates also
proved to be good substrates in this transformation, afording
3l and 3m with comparable enantioselectivities. In addition,
the propargylic carbonates containing five-, six- and eight-
membered cyclic alkyl scafolds reacted smoothly to provide
3n–3q in moderate yields with excellent enantioselectivities
(86–94% ees). Substrates with the ethyl or n-butyl located on
the tertiary carbon atom of the propargylic acetates were also
good reaction partners and led to the corresponding products
3r and 3s in good results.
Next, we then investigated the scope of unsaturated ketox-
imes in this asymmetric reaction. A wide range of
β,γ-unsaturated ketoximes with phenyl rings containing elec-
tron-donating or electron-withdrawing groups at diferent posi-
tions were tolerated well, providing the desired products 4a–4g
in 58–87% yields with 91–94% ees. Moreover, polycyclic aryl,
heteroaryl and alkyl-substituted ketoximes could be employed
to aford 4h–4k in moderate yields with good enantioselectivi-
ties (88–93% ees). In addition, gem-disubstituted alkenes
ketoximes were successful in producing 4l–4o in excellent
yields with 87–91% ees. However, replacing the methyl groups
with other alkyl groups led to 4p and 4q in acceptable yields
with relatively lower enantioselectivities of 77–78% ees.
To demonstrate potential applications, late-stage modifi-
cation of pharmaceuticals and natural products was then con-
ducted (Scheme 3). The clofibrate and fenofibrate derivative
products 4r and 4s were obtained in moderate yields with high
ees. In particular, estrone menthol, carbohydrate and chole-
sterol derived 4t–4w were aforded in good yields with high
diastereoselectivities.
To further explore the utility of this protocol, we carried out

Conclusion
In summary, we have developed a novel Pd-catalyzed enantio-
selective carboetherification reaction of β,γ-unsaturated ketox-
imes with propargylic acetates to aford various chiral isoxazo-
lines bearing multisubstituted allene groups in good yields
with excellent enantioselectivities. This reaction ofers advan-
tages including a general substrate scope, broad functional
group tolerance, good yields and high enantioselectivity. These
highly enantioenriched products are precursors of other useful
chiral building blocks. The photo-physical properties were
further investigated, indicating their potential application in
organic optoelectronic materials. DFT calculations further
indicated that the stereochemistry was regulated by the chiral
ligand-promoted olefin insertion step, wherein the favored
transition state is stabilized by less steric hindrance in the
chiral ligand and the substrates. Further expansion of the
scope of asymmetric Pd-catalyzed reactions is ongoing in our
laboratory.
